What degraded

  • no panel of three scored this deck
    the run reached the frames after its editorial phases had closed, so the machine gates and a read of every frame are what stand behind it. The rubric score is absent rather than estimated
  • aggregate_check is red and numeral_trace is green, over the same numbers
    frame 7's six counted zeros cannot be quoted from a claim. numeral_trace says to declare them in aggregates.json and this run did. aggregate_check then calls each declaration a leftover. Following either breaks the other, and neither runs against a run in CI. Logged as upgrade proposal 5

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it The machine is in a money class, and the announcement never said so, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

House Bill 27 asked for personal finance.

The text the board carried to final adoption asks a student to appraise robot-advisors by fee structure and algorithmic limitation. Students research careers using artificial intelligence tools. They explain how algorithm-driven recommendations shape spending.

It is a graduation requirement, not an elective. There is no AI unit. The attachment still heads itself Text of Proposed New. It has not been checked against the Texas Register filing.

The board's news release sums the standards up in eighteen words. None of them is artificial, algorithm or automated. All three expectations sit inside "and more".

The deck carries all three verbatim.

The item is dated September 4th. The rule takes effect 20 days after filing. Which districts have a teacher ready to grade that appraisal in the 2027 to 2028 school year?

#SBOE #HB27 #TexasTEKS

Every date above is the date this run FETCHED the document. The item prints its own date line, September 4th.

The term counts are computed from the fetched documents, never typed. The release was read as bytes with navigation and footer included and returned zero for artificial, algorithm, automated, machine learning, the token AI and the stem technolog. Whether that absence was deliberate is not knowable from these sources and the record does not guess.
